newsitem.title: UK: New crop LIFFE wheat ends unchanged, old crop down.
newsitem.headline: New crop LIFFE wheat ends unchanged, old crop down.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended with the new crop unchanged and old crop contracts lower, after a day of moves up and down.
Continental sellers pushed prices down early in the day, one trader said. But then consumer buying helped prices to a partial recovery.
In the final stages, news that the EU had decided to suspend its planned daily export tax brought new crop back to unchanged, he said.
Old crop months ended lower, with July last done 0.65 stg lower at 93.10 stg. "It still looks pretty weak on the old crop," the trader said.
January was the most active month, with 172 of the total of 658 lots traded. It last traded at 97.25 stg, unchanged, having seen a low of 96.50 stg and a high of 97.75 during the course of the day.
On barley November was most active, with 27 of a total 36 lots. It last traded 0.50 stg lower at 91.25 stg.
